name: cloud logging finops
description: Non-interactive runs. When no user can answer (e.g. a scheduled or automated run), ask nothing: audit the project named in the request, or the active gcloud project; use --billing-mode=search; cover all five report topics (Step 2.5); and never enable an API or upgrade a log bucket. Put anything that needed a user (a disabled API, a missing role, the upgrade advisory) in the report instead.
